programme.title: Brooklyn's Finest
programme.desc: In the course of one chaotic week, the lives of three conflicted New York City police officers are dramatically transformed by their involvement in a massive drug operation.

programme.title: Christmas With a Crown
programme.desc: When a successful woman returns to her hometown to revive her family's Christmas festival, she meets a dashing stranger who's volunteered to help organise the event. Sparks begin to fly between them, but little does she know that he's really a prince in disguise, longing to find the true spirit of the holidays! It will take a Christmas miracle of royal proportions for their hearts to meet as one.

programme.title: Elf Man
programme.desc: An Elf is left behind by Santa to help rescue the Harper family from a lousy Christmas. The Elf and the family get more than they bargained for, as the kids help the Elf discover his special powers and true identity as a budding superhero.

programme.title: Last Days in the Desert
programme.desc: As Jesus begins his journey out of the wilderness following forty days of fasting and praying, he struggles with the Devil over the fate of a family in crisis. This powerful drama depicting an imagined chapter from Jesus' life stars Golden Globe winner Ewan McGregor (Trainspotting, Star Wars franchise), Academy Award nominee Ciarn Hinds (Belfast, Game of Thrones), and Tye Sheridan (Mud, X-Men franchise).

programme.title: Merry Good Enough
programme.desc: Lucy Raulie has always had a complicated relationship with her family, but when her mother disappears on Christmas Eve, the dysfunctional family hit a new all-time low. Aided by her reluctant siblings in an attempt to bring the family back together, the Raulie kids may get more than they bargained for when their eccentric father, George, also shows up to "help" in the search for their wayward mom. A razor-sharp and delightfully heartwarming festive comedy, packed with classic Christmas songs and a stand-out ensemble cast, including Joel Murray (Mad Men), Sawyer Spielberg (Masters of the Air), Susan Gallagher (Cobra Kai), Neil Casey (Ghostbusters, Avenue 5), Comfort Clinton (Billions, FBI), Sophie von Haselberg (Give Me Pity, Pose) and Raye Spielberg.

programme.title: Miss Me This Christmas
programme.desc: Regina and Franklin are seemingly the perfect couple, but after five years of marriage, a huge fight at Thanksgiving leads them to divorce, set to be finalised on Christmas day. As they try to move on with their lives, will the festive spirit pull them back together? Starring Erica Ash (Scary Movie 5, Survivor's Remorse) and Eva Marcille (The Young and the Restless).

programme.title: Tomboy
programme.desc: A jaw-dropping, audacious revenge thriller, starring Michelle Rodriguez (Fast & Furious) and Sigourney Weaver (Avatar). When top assassin Frank is double crossed and falls into the hands of a rogue surgeon, he wakes up to discover he has undergone gender reassignment surgery. Now a hit-woman, revenge is her only motive, as she goes on a sinister manhunt for the person responsible.

programme.title: For The Sake of Vicious
programme.desc: A tired, unsuspecting nurse returns home to discover that she is in for a long night. Its Halloween night and her one game of trick or treat is about to get out of hand, as the arrival of a criminal and the man holding him hostage force their way into her home. But things turn nuclear when the house comes under siege as wave after wave of violent mercenaries descend to free their captive boss.

programme.title: Slumber
programme.desc: Maggie Q (Designated Survivor) stars in this mind-bending, sleep-paralysis horror. Sleep doctor Alice abandons all rational scientific reasoning while investigating a peculiar family case - a legendary demon that feeds on its victims by paralysing them in their sleep. To help this family from their nightmare, she must confront her own childhood demons to defeat this dark spirit. Truly eye-opening!

programme.title: Come to Daddy
programme.desc: Elijah Wood (The Lord of the Rings) stars in this critically acclaimed, genre-bending horror comedy thatll leave you shocked and in hysterics. After years of no contact, Norval (Wood) visits his estranged father (Stephen McHattie, Watchmen) and quickly discovers he has a shady past. Also starring Michael Smiley (Kill List) and Garfield Wilson (The Man in the High Castle).

programme.title: Extracurricular
programme.desc: An entertaining blast of mean-spirited genre thrills, starring Luke Goss (Bros fame). Four high school seniors make a pact to execute a series of perfect, elaborate murders and get some thrills behind them before going to college. But when a homicidal plan hits some unexpected speed bumps, the situation turns deadly.

programme.title: Motherland
programme.desc: In an alternate society where the state frees parents from the burden of raising children, a rule enforcer learns a shocking truth that sparks her rebellion.

programme.title: We Have Always Lived in the Castle
programme.desc: A twisted mystery based on the acclaimed novel by Shirley Jackson ('The Haunting of Hill House'). Merricat (Taissa Farmiga - 'The Nun') lives with her sister Constance (Alexandra Daddario - 'Baywatch') and her Uncle Julian (Crispin Glover - 'Back to the Future').

programme.title: Trapped
programme.desc: Academy Award® nominees Naomi Watts (King Kong, Mulholland Drive) and Matt Dillon (There's Something About Mary, Crash) star in this thrilling and intense story about a young couple at odds with the American Dream. Melissa Winters (Watts) works as a cashier at the bleak local convenience store...

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: Rex is based on the true-life story of young Marine Corporal Megan Leavey whose unique discipline and bond with her military combat dog saved many lives during their deployment in Iraq.

programme.title: The Christmas Pageant
programme.desc: (2011) Festive romance starring Melissa Gilbert. A temperamental director is forced to direct a Christmas pageant. She finds herself swept up by the magic of Christmas, and an ex-lover.

programme.title: Reunited at Christmas
programme.desc: (2018) Christmas romance with Nikki DeLoach. When Sam's fractured family gathers for one last Christmas at her late grandmother's home, will reviving lost festive traditions lead to second chances?

programme.title: Christmas Crush
programme.desc: Addie makes a whimsical Christmas wish for her next-door neighbour to fall in love with her. But will she be able to break the spell when her wish goes awry? Starring Cindy Sampson (2019)

programme.title: Mingle All the Way
programme.desc: (2018) Christmas romance with Jen Lilley. While testing her networking app, Molly finds an unlikely plus-one for the festive season. But will strictly business turn into something more?

programme.title: Destination Wedding
programme.desc: Forced to tolerate each other for a few days, two cynical wedding guests strike an unexpected alliance.

programme.title: The Swearing Jar
programme.desc: "The Swearing Jar" is a gorgeous musical romance that asks the question — is it possible to meet your "one true love", twice?

programme.title: If You Were the Last
programme.desc: Three years into a NASA mission that has gone very wrong, astronauts Adam (Anthony Mackie) and Jane (Zoe Chao) are stuck adrift between Jupiter and Saturn in a broken-down space shuttle.

programme.title: Almost Love
programme.desc: Adam and Marklin's 5-year relationship has gone from a passionate flame to a simmer, forcing them to reconcile with each other's shortcomings while their friends endlessly search for love in New York City.

programme.title: Romance Retreat
programme.desc: After a break-up, journalist Dana Willingham finds herself alone and stuck at a couple's yoga retreat while the biggest story of her career breaks far away. But when she meets handsome fellow retreater Stefan Gonzales who's lying low after being the center of a scandal, she smells a good story.

programme.title: The Flight Before Christmas
programme.desc: Starring Mayim Bialik and Ryan McPartlin. Two strangers offer to share the last remaining room at a bed-and-breakfast when a snowstorm strands their flight in Montana on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: A Christmas to Savour
programme.desc: Scarlett is a chef but every year her holiday dishes never sell. So this year, her best friend buys her a ticket for a holiday...maybe she will find love in a handsome rival chef from her past, and regain the Christmas spirit.

programme.title: At Sachem Farm
programme.desc: Ross plans to sell his family's wine collection to finance a mining interest, but standing in his way is Uncle Cullen, who has different plans for the family estate.

programme.title: A Christmas Princess
programme.desc: A prince from Europe comes to New York for a royal holiday dinner and falls in love with the chef that is planning the event.

programme.title: Love in Focus
programme.desc: When the hit show actress Jenna Wilde stars in suddenly gets cancelled, the press start circling. To escape the chaos Jenna retreats to a snowy cabin in the mountains. Unexpectedly, she must share this peaceful place with a rude and rugged nature photographer Chris Dixon. Their coolness towards each other starts to thaw when Chris helps Jenna audition for other shows.

programme.title: Love's Portrait
programme.desc: Lily, a museum curator, discovers a painting that looks just like her and is sent to find where the painting came from and who painted it. She tracks the painting down to the post office it was sent from in Ireland. There she meets William and Saoirse, a brother-sister duo who run the post, and who offer her help and friendship on her quest. But William knows more than he's letting on. Will he reveal what he knows if it risks his growing relationship--and mutual love--with Lily?

programme.title: Not Cinderella's Type
programme.desc: Indy lives with her aunt and uncle and believes her life is fine until an accident brings a new guy into her life. Bryant Bailey is not Indy's type - she's never been into guys like him. But then again, she's never really known anyone so stubborn and caring that can also help her discover who she is and what she's worth. A modern telling of Cinderella, based on the novel by Jenni James.

programme.title: Finding Love In Sisters
programme.desc: When her mother dies, Esperanza returns to Sisters, Oregon and reunites with her sisters.

programme.title: Grumpy Cat's Worst Christmas Ever
programme.desc: Grumpy Cat, with 6m Facebook fans, stars in a Lifetime movie.

programme.title: Holiday Spin
programme.desc: Ralph Macchio stars as a former dance champion sidelined years ago by an injury.

programme.title: Holiday Wishes
programme.desc: Britney and Rachel swap lives after meeting Santa.

programme.title: The Christmas Trap.
programme.desc: Couple on brink of divorce stuck in elevator on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: Ex Next Door
programme.desc: A happy couple's life turns upside down when the husband's ex-girlfriend moves in next door.

programme.title: Love at Sunset Terrace
programme.desc: A girl tries to play matchmaker for her widowed father when a woman rents one of his rooms.

programme.title: At Home With Tori
programme.desc: Tori is hosting a 90210 themed party and wants to create some classic Beverly Hills appys.

programme.title: Kidnapped to the Island
programme.desc: When a teen aspiring to be a pop star disappears, her mom tracks her down, uncovering a sinister plot.

programme.title: Amber's Story
programme.desc: This is the true story of the kidnapping of Amber Hagerman and how her family came together to help other abducted children as a result of her tragedy which resulted in a new system to help find missing children - The Amber Alert.

programme.title: Drinking Buddies
programme.desc: Luke and Kate are co-workers at a Chicago brewery, where they spend their days drinking and flirting. They're perfect for each other, except that they're both in relationships.

programme.title: Friends with Benefits
programme.desc: When two friends decide to try something new and take advantage of their mutual attraction without any emotional attachment, they soon realize romantic comedy stereotypes might exist for a reason.

programme.title: Another You
programme.desc: ANOTHER YOU is the uproarious slapstick comedy about a pathological liar who, upon his release from a mental clinic, becomes involved with a con man and ends up impersonating a billionaire. Scam follows double-scam in classic Pryor/Wilder style. Features Academy Award winner Mercedes Ruehl as a con who falls for Gene Wilder.

programme.title: Friends With Money
programme.desc: Three well-heeled married women and their single, financially challenged friend negotiate the waters of friendship, relationships, careers and money.

programme.title: Somebody I Used To Know
programme.desc: On a trip to her hometown, workaholic Ally spends a whirlwind night with her ex-boyfriend Sean which makes her question all the past choices she's made. Ally decides she has to Sean back...which gets much more complicated when she meets his fiancé.

programme.title: Unfinished Business
programme.desc: A hard-working small business owner and his two associates travel to Europe to close the most important deal of their lives. But what began as a routine business trip goes off the rails in every imaginable – and unimaginable – way...

programme.title: Bottoms
programme.desc: In this refreshingly outspoken and raunchy comedy, two unpopular girls in their senior year of high school start a fight club to try to impress and hook up with cheerleaders. And their bizarre plan works! But are they in over their heads?

programme.title: Landscape With Invisible Hand
programme.desc: In the near future, when an occupying alien species' bureaucratic rule and advanced technology leaves most of Earth impoverished and unemployed, two teenagers hatch a risky plan to ensure their families' futures.

programme.title: The Pink Panther
programme.desc: When a star soccer coach is murdered and his priceless Pink Panther diamond stolen, France is in an uproar. Fortunately, Inspector Jacques Clouseau (Steve Martin) is on the case with his trusted partner Gilbert Ponton (Jean Reno). Will he seduce the pop diva, Xania (Beyoncé Knowles)?

programme.title: Lightning Jack
programme.desc: Lightning Jack Kane is an Australian outlaw in the wild west. During a bungled bank robbery he picks up mute Ben Doyle as a hostage. The two become good friends, with Jack teaching Ben how to rob banks, while they plan Jack's last heist.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: Ted Hayden impersonates a wanted man and joins Gentry's gang only to learn later that Gentry was the one who killed his father. He saves Virginia Winters' dad's ranch from Gentry and also rescues his long-lost brother Spud.

programme.title: The Over-the-Hill Gang Rides Again
programme.desc: Retired Texas Ranger Nash Crawford re-assembles his former Ranger outfit from the old days to fight crime in his hometown.

programme.title: Drums in the Deep South
programme.desc: Best friends Clay Clayburn and Will Denning graduate from West Point before the Civil War forces them onto opposing sides. Unaware they face each other in battle, they risk becoming enemies on the battlefield. Meanwhile, Kathy Summers, who cares deeply for both men, desperately tries to prevent a tragic confrontation.

programme.title: Incredible Rocky Mountain Race
programme.desc: An old man observes a boy bullying his playmates and treats him to a morality lesson. The man tells the story of the epic cross-country race between a young Mark Twain and his rival, Mike Fink.

programme.title: Personal Affair
programme.desc: When a teenaged student disappears, her teacher is suspected of killing her.

programme.title: Portrait From Life
programme.desc: Major Lawrence wanders into an art gallery and is struck by the beauty of a young girl in a painting.

programme.title: Proud Valley
programme.desc: David Goliath, an unemployed stoker from a Cardiff, is making his way up the Welsh valleys in search of work.

programme.title: Rome Express
programme.desc: A tense story of robbery, intrigue and murder which takes place on a trans-continental train.

programme.title: Band Waggon
programme.desc: After eviction from Broadcasting House, Arthur and Stinker stage a TV show in a castle used by German agents.

programme.title: Season of the Witch
programme.desc: Fourteenth century knights transport a suspected witch to a monastery, where monks deduce her powers could be the source of the Black Plague.

programme.title: The Wild Geese
programme.desc: Richard Burton, Roger Moore and Richard Harris star as a team of mercenaries hired by a wealthy industrialist for one final mission: Recruit and train a squad of commandos, parachute into an African nation, snatch its deposed President from a prison and escape, and kill anyone who gets in their way.

programme.title: Arcadia
programme.desc: In the not too distant future, the population has risen to dangerous numbers and a deadly disease has gripped the world. To combat the death toll rising, 'Arcadia' has been built as a safe disease-free haven for the privileged, where life expectancy is more than 130 years.

programme.title: A Murder in Oakland
programme.desc: Recently cleared of an embezzlement charge, Detective Williams (Marcus D Spencer) is handed a high-profile murder case while also forced to take on a new partner. Williams is trying to solve this case while also working to see if he can trust his partner.

programme.title: Programming will resume shortly
programme.desc: We're catching up on our beauty sleep! Stay tuned for more priceless entertainment curated by Rakuten TV.

programme.title: The Twisters
programme.desc: Dozens of deadly tornadoes converge in the Midwest, merging into a mega twister set to obliterate everything for hundreds of miles.

programme.title: Dagger of Death
programme.desc: India, 500 A.D.: A precious dagger is used in human sacrifices to goddess Kali. Sydney must return a relic to India for her fellow hunter, who believes the dagger made him kill his assistant.

programme.title: Last of the Mochicas
programme.desc: On a search for a South American Mochica Indian relic of protection, Nigel and his colleagues get captured by local guerrillas. It's up to Sydney and ally Jason Clark to save them.

programme.title: Fertile Ground
programme.desc: Sydney reunites with her high school sweetheart to track down a Hawaiian fertility idol in Madagascar.

programme.title: Gypsy Jigsaw
programme.desc: Sydney receives a deck of rare Tarot cards from her recently deceased friend. The infamous, previously unmentioned Vulture was after him. Sydney enlists Claudia to help.

programme.title: Three Rivers to Cross
programme.desc: According to local monks, the Famed Jade Empress is hidden in the valley that will be flooded when the Three Rivers Dam's flood gates have their grand opening.

programme.title: Lost Contact
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel and billionaire entrepreneur Rod Thorson parachute into the Myanmar jungle to rescue a relic-hunting team hired by Thorson to locate an ancient sacrificial bowl.

programme.title: Cross of Voodoo
programme.desc: When two graduate students on the trail of the Haitian Cross of Utu disappear in New Orleans, Sydney and Nigel go down on the bayou to find them.

programme.title: Roman Holiday
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel are on a trip, so Claudia decides to help Sydney's friend Roger to find Julius Caesar's armor, but relic hunting is not her talent.

programme.title: Proud Mary
programme.desc: A hit woman's life is turned completely around when she meets a young boy who awakens in her a maternal instinct she never knew she had.

programme.title: The Art Of War
programme.desc: Shaw is an operative for the United Nations' covert dirty-tricks squad, using espionage and quasi-ethical tactics to secure peace and cooperation. When a shipping container full of dead Vietnamese refugees turns up on the docks and China's ambassador is gunned down at a dinner celebrating a new trade agreement with China and the US, Shaw is framed for the murder and must evade the FBI and Triad gangsters to find out what is really going on.

programme.title: Black Dawn (2005)
programme.desc: CIA Agent, Jonathan Cold is working undercover to determine who are the arms dealers, who want to sell a nuclear bomb to an Eastern European terrorist group. His cover gets detected when the weapons dealers catch his former student, beautiful Amanda Hayes. Cold fights to get her out. Together they go after the bomb and find out that Hayes' boss is involved in the bombing. At the end they vanquish all there enemies and have to drop off the activated bomb over the ocean.

programme.title: All The Money in The World
programme.desc: After the kidnapping of John Paul Getty III, in a race against time, his mother works to convince his wealthy grandfather to pay the ransom. Inspired by historical events. Certain scenes, characters and dialogue have been fictionalized for dramatic purposes.

programme.title: Alvarez Kelly
programme.desc: A profiteer and cattleman plays the North and South against each other until kidnapped by a Confederate.

programme.title: The Doolins Of Oklahoma
programme.desc: A fugitive's attempt to go straight is undercut by the return of his old gang.

programme.title: Seminole Uprising
programme.desc: A calvary officer is ordered to bring in a rampaging Seminole leader and a bloody battle ensues.

programme.title: One Man Law
programme.desc: Ellis, a city stickler buys land for one set of tenants as that deed is sold to another, when trouble erupts.

programme.title: Riders Of Black River
programme.desc: A Former Texas Ranger returns to his home town to find that the territory is in the grip of cattle rustlers.

programme.title: Ten Wanted Men
programme.desc: A noble cattleman battles an embittered, rival rancher, who hires ten outlaws to seize power in the territory.

programme.title: Dead Awake
programme.desc: Kate Bowman is a by-the-books social worker who is investigating a series of mysterious deaths. Each victim suffered from sleep paralysis, a frightening ailment that immobilizes its victims as they dream. Kate is approached by an unorthodox doctor who warns of an evil entity that haunts people in their sleep. She brushes aside his admonition, but when a terrifying entity begins to haunt Kate's friends and loved ones, she must fight to stay awake to stop the nightmare she's unleashed.

programme.title: Doppelganger [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A writer with a room for rent acquires a strange new roommate with a psychotic alter-ego that follows her wherever she goes.

programme.title: Charade
programme.desc: Before discovering her husband has been murdered in Paris, Regina Lampert falls for the charming Peter Joshua. Starring legendary screen icons Audrey Hepburn and Cary Grant.

programme.title: Guns Of Redemption [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A scarred gunslinger tries leaving violence behind, but his past catches up. Near death from an ambush, he straps on his guns for one final mission.

programme.title: JCVD [English-Language Version] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme gets involved in a bank robbery with hostages situation and reflects about his life during it.

programme.title: A Better Tomorrow II [English-Language Version] [Broadcast Edit]

programme.title: La Velle
programme.sub-title: Rhoda Scott & La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. "It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.” This performance at the French Festival Jazz à Vienne is extra special. Not only because of the beautiful location, but also because she shares the stage with American gospel and blues singer La Velle. Together they give an intimate and beautiful show in the antique theatre of Vienne.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist's career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah
programme.sub-title: Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music” an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah's quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: Dexter Gordon
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Buster Williams
programme.sub-title: Ode to Miles: Bitches Brew Beyond
programme.desc: For the 40th anniversary of jazz legend Miles Davis' legendary album Bitches Brew, trumpeter Wallace Roney leads a band that revives the master's music. This project is the brainchild of Miles' family (including his son Erin), which is represented by his nephew, drummer Vince Wilburn. This concert at the ancient theater in Vienne, France, is a grand tribute to Miles.

programme.title: Bill Evans
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Spyro Gyra
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, the American jazz fusion band Spyro Gyra took the stage at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Having struck gold with their album "Morning Dance" just a few years prior, they played a slick set with exuberant energy.

programme.title: Fabio Luisi, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & In Mo Yang
programme.sub-title: Luisi conducts Paganini's Violin Concerto & Brahms
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of two great works. Paganini's Violin Concerto No. 1. is paired with Brahms' dramatic symphonic debut, Symphony No.1. Paganini's concerto dates from the mid-to-late 1810s, written as the composer was touring Italy with his remarkable violin technique. This piece is a quintessential expression of Paganini's extraordinary skill and ability, demanding much from the soloist. It is also characterized by the notably operatic “bel canto” style adopted by many of the composer's contemporaries, including Gioachino Rossini. This exceptional performance features the dazzling virtuosity of violinist In Mo Yang, winner of the 2015 Paganini Competition. It was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2017.

programme.title: Christine Nonbo Andersen, Tuva Semmingsen, David Bateson & Steffen Bruun
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: Beatrice Rana, Gianandrea Noseda & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 5 in E-flat major, Op. 73, famously known as the ‘Emperor' Concerto. Italian pianist Beatrice Rana features as the soloist here. The New York Times describes her as ‘one of the most insightful and prodigiously gifted artists of the new generation'. Beethoven's Fifth Piano Concerto opens with a grand, majestic chord followed by a brilliant flourish from the piano, setting the tone for one of the most celebrated works in the piano repertoire. Composed between 1809 and 1811, it reflects Beethoven's heroic spirit during a turbulent period in European history and is admired for its boldness, lyricism, and virtuosic demands. This concert was recorded at London's Barbican Hall, UK, on February 2, 2022.

programme.title: Benjamin Haemhouts, Casco Phil & Geert Baeckelandt
programme.sub-title: Mozart – Clarinet Concerto in A Major
programme.desc: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart wrote his last completely instrumental piece in 1791. Clarinet Concerto in A Major was written for his friend Anton Stadler, who gave the first performance of it in Prague to a great reception according to the Berlin Musikalisches Wochenblatt. Today, a major part of the first movement is often used in auditions for orchestras and music schools. In this broadcast, the piece is performed by Casco Phil, a Belgian chamber orchestra led by Benjamin Haemhouts. Belgian clarinettist Geert Baeckelandt is the featured soloist.

programme.title: Ballet of the Mariinsky Theatre
programme.desc: 'La Bayadère' is a three-act ballet by the French choreographer Marius Petipa. Set in 19th-century India, 'La Bayadère' tells the sad love story of the noble warrior Solor and his Nikia, a temple dancer or 'bayadère', who is poisoned by her rival, Gamzatti. The ballet features one of the most celebrated scenes of classical ballet, namely 'The Kingdom of the Shades'. In this iconic scene, Solor dreams, under the influence of opium, of reuniting with his beloved Nikia. This production of the ballet features the revised choreography by Vladimir Ponomarev and Vakhtang Chabukiani (1941), and includes dances by Konstantin Sergeyev and Nikolai Zubkovsky. The ballet's music, composed by Ludwig Minkus, is performed by the Mariinsky Orchestra under the direction of Boris Gruzin. Among the performers are Viktoria Tereshkina, Anastasia Matvienko, Vladimir Shklyarov, and Vladimir Ponomarev. This performance was recorded at the Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg, Russia, in July 2014.

programme.title: Royal Opera Orchestra & Andres Gabetta
programme.desc: We all know "The Four Seasons of Vivaldi", it is one of the "hits" of classical music. What if the Antonio Vivaldi's famous Four Seasons had been preceded by those of Giovanni Antonio Guido, star violinist of Parisian orchestras of the maturity of Louis XIV? The two works are finally presented in the same program in spite of their differences: the well-known virtuosity of Vivaldi's work contrasts with the mixture of French good taste and Italian features of Guido's Seasons. It is also the first time that the version with strings and winds is filmed. For this exciting confrontation, the Royal Opera Orchestra will be conducted by the virtuoso Andrès Gabetta, from his 1727 Venetian Pietro Guarneri violin, an exact contemporary of these Eight Seasons!

programme.title: Electric Light Orchestra
programme.desc: Captured live at London's Wembley Arena and directed by Mike Mansfield this space-age show will live forever in rock history as, quite literally, out of this world featuring a pioneering laser display, the first of its kind that set a precedent for subsequent rock shows. 'Standing in the Rain', 'Night in The Rain', 'Turn to Stone', 'Tight Rope', 'Telephone Line', 'Rock Aria', 'Wild West Hero', 'Show Down', 'Sweet Talking Woman', 'Roll Over Beethoven'.

programme.title: Rod Stewart
programme.desc: A concert by the legendary Rod Stewart, that closed Radio 2's Annual Festival In A Day, held in September 2015 in London's Hyde Park.

programme.title: Neil Young
programme.desc: Following on from this label's previous Neil Young DVD documentary, The First Decade, comes this second instalment focusing on the great man's career between the years 1976 and 2006 with the help of obscure archive footage, rare film of Neil Young in performance and in the studio and contributions from those he worked with closely during this period.

programme.title: Peter Gabriel
programme.desc: Filmed at the Hammersmith Apollo in March 2011, "New Blood - Live In London" captures Peter Gabriel performing live with the 46 piece New Blood Orchestra. The repertoire mixes cover versions from his "Scratch My Back" album with classic tracks from across his solo career in brand new orchestral arrangements. Gabriel is a renowned live performer and his onstage charisma and instantly recognisable voice combine brilliantly with the orchestral sound palette to breathe a new sense of wonder into familiar songs. As you would expect the concert is also a visual feast, with graphics, animation and imagery blending to enhance and illustrate the music. This is truly a live experience not to be missed.

programme.title: Genesis
programme.desc: “Sum Of The Parts” is the official authorised story of Genesis made with the full co-operation of the band members. It explores the dynamics of the group that has enabled them to survive changes of line-up, see their musical direction steadily evolve and maintain both group and solo careers along with their enduring popularity as evidenced by their hugely successful 2007 reunion tour.

programme.title: Corrupt
programme.desc: Hallie Jones era una contable forense para la oficina del fiscal des distrito hasta que su testimonio le costó la vida a un hombre inocente. Pero cuando el testigo clave de un importante caso de corrupción aparece muerto, el fiscal del distrito Frank Morries, pedirá ayuda a la única persona que puede resolver el caso: Hallie. Pero a medida que empieza a descubrir la verdad sobre el caso, también sale a la luz una peligrosa red de mentiras y engaños que la ponen cada vez más en peligo.

programme.title: El séptimo continente (V.O.S.E.)
programme.desc: Una familia europea burguesa que planea escapar a Australia para desprenderse de todos sus bienes y vivir según una concepción espiritual del mundo, parece atrapada en su rutina diaria, solo preocupada por incidentes menores. Sin embargo, detrás de su aparente calma y existencia repetitiva, en realidad están planeando algo siniestro.

programme.title: Joe, el implacable
programme.desc: El oeste americano a mediados de 1800 es una tierra sin ley. Allí, una banda de forajidos saquea las llanuras y asesina a mujeres y niños indígenas inocentes. Hasta que Joe, un guerrero navajo decidido a vengar a su tribu, se interpone en su camino.

programme.title: La mujer zurda
programme.desc: Después de pasar unos días sin verse, Marianne se encuentra con Bruno, su marido, y le comunica que deberían separarse. La mujer y su hijo se trasladan a Francia y se instalan en una gran casa medio vacía rodeada de trenes. Allí realiza traducciones para sobrevivir, mientras su calidad de exiliada alemana en un París contemporáneo y hostil la encamina lentamente hacia la locura.

programme.title: Los malditos (V.O.)
programme.desc: Oslo, 1945. Cuando el Tercer Reich agoniza, el doctor Guibert es secuestrado para tratar a un herido en un submarino con el que un grupo de nazis y simpatizantes tratan de huir a Sudamérica. Entre ellos figuran un general alemán, un jefe de la Gestapo, un industrial italiano y su esposa, y un periodista colaboracionista. Cuando se recibe la noticia del armisticio, estalla un motín a bordo del submarino.

programme.title: Gangster Nº 1
programme.desc: Narrando la brutalidad que lo condujo al triunfo y al temor, un hombre relata su juventud como mafioso anónimo en el Londres de los años sesenta. Siguiendo los pasos de su jefe, Freddie Mays, parecía dispuesto a hacer cualquier cosa por él. Sin embargo, una envidia desmedida fue alimentando su crueldad, llevándolo a la traición para convertirse en el gánster número uno.

programme.title: Las nuevas aventuras de Aladino
programme.desc: Un par de perdedores que trabajan en unos grandes almacenes planean robar el lugar después de que cierre. Cuando un grupo de niños aparece rogando que les cuenten una historia, los hombres comienzan una versión improvisada de Aladino.

programme.title: El club de los incomprendidos
programme.desc: Basada en la novela de Francisco de Paula. Un grupo de adolescentes castigados en el instituto descubre la amistad y el amor mientras comparten sus problemas. En elenco podemos ver a Ivana Baquero, Patrick Criado, Aitana Sánchez-Gijón o Raúl Arévalo.

programme.title: Escobar: Paraíso perdido
programme.desc: El joven surfista Nick (Josh Hutcherson) se enamora perdidamente de una hermosa chica. Todo parece perfecto hasta que conoce al tío de ella, el famoso capo de la droga Pablo Escobar (Benicio Del Toro).

programme.title: Si tan solo hubiera
programme.desc: ¿Por qué muere el amor y los recuerdos se vuelven un lamento de lo que pudo ser?

programme.title: Regalo de Enamorados
programme.desc: Un accidente de moto transforma la vida de Javier y le revela un amor inesperado.

programme.title: Sweet Home
programme.desc: Alicia sorprende a su novio Simón con una cena romántica para dos en un edificio casi abandonado.

programme.title: Paintball: Juega para sobrevivir
programme.desc: Desconocidos deseosos por vivir nuevas experiencias viaja hasta un recóndito lugar de la Europa del este.

programme.title: Duelo en las profundidades
programme.desc: Es el oro de Silas McGee. Aún no lo ha encontrado, aunque lleva más de 30 años buscándolo.

programme.title: Queen & Slim
programme.desc: Tras una ligera infracción de tráfico, un hombre (Daniel Kaluuya) y una mujer de color (Jodie Turner-Smith) que disfrutan de su primera cita, son parados por la policía.

programme.title: El mensajero
programme.desc: Brillante thriller entretenido y con mensaje sobre un padre (Dwayne Johnson) que, desesperado después de que su hijo sea acusado por error en un caso de tráfico de drogas, se ve obligado por la DEA a infiltrarse en un peligroso cártel donde deberá arriesgar su propia vida para salvar la de su hijo.

programme.title: La indignada Annie
programme.desc: Cuando Annie, una madre trabajadora de dos niños, se queda embarazada de forma repentina contacta con la MLAC una organización que practica el aborto ilegal. Acogida por el movimiento, Annie encontrará en la lucha por la adopción de una ley sobre el aborto un nuevo sentido a su vida.

programme.title: Skybound
programme.desc: Cinco amigos a bordo de un pequeño avión rumbo a Los Ángeles pierden misteriosamente la conexión por radio. Cuando descubren a Erik, un polizón que les insta a no aterrizar, asumen que un gran desastre ha tenido lugar en la superficie.

programme.title: Perdidos En El Sol
programme.desc: La historia de John, un delincuente de poca monta, que encuentra un inesperado cómplice en Louis, un adolescente que acaba de quedarse huérfano.

programme.title: El puente de San Luis Rey
programme.desc: En el Perú de 1714, un fraile es juzgado por la Inquisición por cuestionar las intenciones de Dios cuando cinco personas mueren en el derrumbe de un puente de cuerdas andino.

programme.title: Miss you already
programme.desc: La amistad entre dos amigas de toda la vida se pone a prueba cuando una comienza una familia y la otra cae enferma.

programme.title: Contra
programme.desc: El profesor Richard Pohl se hace viral tras un comentario xenófobo en clase: insulta a Naima Hamid, estudiante de Derecho, delante de todos sus compañeros.

programme.title: El problema con el muérdago
programme.desc: Reencuentro con un primer amor: el reto de no caer dos veces.

programme.title: El Principe Enamorado
programme.desc: El Príncipe Carlos llega a la Costa Brava con la intención de pasar unas semanas de descanso.

programme.desc: Una novia rusa que quiere conseguir el permiso de residencia es encargada por correo.

programme.title: Amor a Primera Visa
programme.desc: Tras su fiesta de despedida, despierta en el apartamento de un apuesto mariachi y padre soltero.

programme.title: Palm Springs
programme.desc: Dos desconocidos atrapados en un bucle temporal.

programme.title: Novia Por Conveniencia

programme.title: La vecina de al lado
programme.desc: Matthew, es un joven ambicioso que sueña con llegar a ser político algún día. De pronto, se enamora perdidamente de Danielle, su vecina de la puerta de al lado. Ambos comienzan un romance, pero un sorprendente descubrimiento pondrá a prueba su relación: ella fue actriz porno.

programme.title: Nora
programme.desc: Dublín, 1904, James Joyce conversa con Nora Barnacle, una empleada de hotel recién llegada de Galway. Ella lo encanta con su manera franca y desinhibida y, en poco tiempo, él la convence para que lo acompañe a Trieste.

programme.title: Afterglow
programme.desc: Un manitas con problemas matrimoniales se encuentra con un ama de casa con los mismos.

programme.title: Regreso a Howards End
programme.desc: Inglaterra, finales del siglo XIX. Margaret y Helen Schlegel son dos hermanas cultas y emancipadas para la época en que viven. Su amistad con la tradicional familia Wilcox acaba en desencuentro. Sin embargo, pasado cierto tiempo, se establece una estrecha relación entre Margaret y la señora Wilcox, quien, para disgusto de su familia, decide nombrar heredera de su mansión a la mayor de las Schlegel.

programme.title: Miss Julie
programme.desc: Una sociedad rígidamente clasista es el obstáculo que se opone a la relación entre Miss Julie, la hija de un conde, y Jean, un sirviente.

programme.title: La casa al final de la calle
programme.desc: Elissa y su madre se mudan a una pequeña ciudad, al lado de una casa donde una joven asesinó a sus padres. Los habitantes del lugar afirman que la chica desapareció misteriosamente después del incidente. Elissa entabla amistad con el hermano de la presunta asesina y pronto percibe que un oscuro y terrible secreto todavía acecha dentro de esas paredes. Una siniestra historia de asesinatos que está lejos de terminar.

programme.title: Esperando la hora
programme.desc: Cuatro mujeres jóvenes tienen en común la precariedad laboral y la esperanza de conseguir un contrato sin fecha de caducidad que les permita encauzar sus vidas. La llegada de una nueva empleada rompe su estabilidad laboral y personal.

programme.title: Los tigres del tren
programme.desc: Un ferroviario en la China de 1941 lucha contra los japoneses para lograr comida para los pobres.

programme.title: Cambio de rumbo
programme.desc: Rupert tiene 24 horas para cambiar radicalmente su vida o perder a Alison, la mujer a la que ama.

programme.title: La Coartada
programme.desc: Ray Elliott tiene un trabajo muy especial: se dedica a encubrir las relaciones matrimoniales de sus clientes.

programme.title: La boda de Rosa
programme.desc: A punto de cumplir 45 años, Rosa decide dejarlo todo atrás y tomar las riendas de su vida.

programme.title: ¿Venís juntos?
programme.desc: Cuando Joel (Paul Rudd) y Molly (Amy Poehler) se conocen, surge el odio a primera vista: la gran empresa de él, Corporate Candy Company, amenaza con cerrar la pequeña y original tienda de caramelos de ella.

programme.title: Los babymakers
programme.desc: Divertida comedia cargada de chistes sexuales sobre un hombre que, tras varios intentos de dejar embarazada a su mujer sin éxito, pide a sus amigos que roben el depósito de esperma que años atrás dejó en un banco de donaciones. Empieza una divertida misión con un solo objetivo: tener un hijo.

programme.title: Asesinos internacionales
programme.desc: Roman Melnyk, jefe de construcción, y Jake Bonanos, controlador aéreo, son doscompletos desconocidos, pero sus vidas quedan fuertemente unidas después de una terrible catástrofe.

programme.title: Diario de un ejecutivo agresivo
programme.desc: Jack es un agente literario con una exitosa trayectoria profesional. De repente su vida da un vuelco: se entera de que su mujer lo engaña con su mejor cliente, le roban en su casa y le dan una paliza.

programme.title: La hermana del novio
programme.desc: Audrey cumplirá 40 años y su hermano se casará con una chica que conoció en Francia. Antes de la boda se revela un secreto, Audrey y la joven prometida no se llevan bien.

programme.title: Atraco En La Iglesia
programme.desc: Durell Washington y LeeJohn Jackson son dos amigos que se quieren como hermanos. También son un par de torpes delincuentes de poca monta. Cuando Durell se entera de que su ex-novia planea para mudarse a otro estado con su hijo, Durell Jr. - a menos que puedan obtener 17.000 dólares para pagar una deuda - a él y a LeeJohn se les ocurre un plan definitivo y desesperado: atracar la iglesia del barrio. Cuando el dúo se las apaña para irrumpir en la iglesia, descubre que alguien ha jugado. Para conseguir el dinero, Durell y LeeJohn se ven obligados a pasar la noche en presencia del Señor y sus seguidores, consiguiendo un botín mucho mayor de lo que esperaban.

programme.title: Aventuras En La Casa Branca
programme.desc: Dos adolescentes despistados se ven involucrados sin darse cuenta en el escándalo del Watergate que provocó la caída del gobierno de Nixon.

programme.title: Casi Famosos
programme.desc: Un joven estudiante recibe la oportunidad de escribir un artículo para un prestigiosa revista de música acerca de un nuevo grupo de rock. Al acompañarles durante su gira irá descubriendo poco a poco el mundo que les rodea.

programme.title: Más allá de la ley
programme.desc: Un trío de ladrones conspira para robar el cargamento de plata de un pueblo, pero un giro de los acontecimientos los convierte en los héroes del pueblo.

programme.title: El Ahorcado
programme.desc: Milagrosamente aún vivo después de su ahorcamiento, el pistolero James Devlin defiende la granja de una joven viuda de un vicioso acaparador de tierras.

programme.title: La batalla de los rancheros
programme.desc: Antigua película del Oeste protagonizada por Brian Donlevy: La batalla de los rancheros - Las disputas por la propiedad de un hombre muerto se convierten en una sangrienta guerra en el campo.

programme.title: Texas, 1870
programme.desc: Los ciudadanos de Hobsonville contratan a un pistolero para deshacerse del clan McIntock que grava a la fuerza e ilegalmente a la gente del pueblo con el pretexto del desarrollo del pueblo.

programme.title: Dónde diablos está el oro
programme.desc: En 1895, los forajidos Cross y Boone se ven obligados a llevar a las autoridades mexicanas su botín. Viajan hasta allí en un tren lleno de dinamita con un grupo de prostitutas. Los rebeldes mexicanos, los indios y los agentes de la Wells Fargo les persiguen.

Gabriel, un profesor de filosofía y lógica en la escuela nocturna, se verá inmerso en tratar de entender el significado de los dibujos proféticos de Benjamín Solari Parravicini, un artista argentino que predijo el evento del 11-S del WTC en 1939, y otros eventos históricos.

programme.title: Por culpa de las gallinas
programme.desc: Pedrín y Yoe crecen como hermanos en un pequeño pueblo, hasta que una disputa entre sus madres por unas gallinas pone a prueba su amistad. Sin embargo, ni los conflictos ni el orgullo podrán romper el lazo que los une desde la infancia.

programme.title: Los Super
programme.desc: Cristina, Belisario y Benito se convierten en guardianes de la justicia para combatir la delincuencia del barrio, y acaban enfrentándose a un malvado empresario que quiere sacar provecho político de un peligroso virus.

programme.title: El Callejón
programme.desc: Una mujer conoce a un cantante de country mientras espera noticias de su marido desaparecido.

programme.title: Atrapados
programme.desc: Mary es una psicóloga infantil que vive en una aislada casa del bosque con su hijastro Stephen, un adolescente en estado vegetativo desde el accidente de coche en el que murió su padre. Mary ha decidido trasladarle a un centro especializado en el cuidado de pacientes como él, pero antes debe prepararse para pasar una gran tormenta que se acerca.

programme.title: The convent. El convento del diablo
programme.desc: El colegio femenino de St. Francis fue cerrado hace décadas debido a una horrible historia que allí sucedió. Una joven llamada Christine al parecer asesinó a varias monjas y un sacerdote, y ahora vive aislada en una de las casas del pueblo. El convento sirve de marco para innumerables leyendas, y tradiciones como pintar las letras del colegio en la torre antes de comenzar el juego de la hermandad escolar. Un grupo de amigos decide ir al viejo edificio para realizar la pintada y de paso tener allí una pequeña fiesta. Pero aparece una pareja de policías, y los jóvenes deben irse del lugar, dejando allí sola a una de las chicas. Cuando regresen, se encontrarán con que terribles fuerzas habitan el lugar...

programme.title: The Princess Blade
programme.desc: Yuki pertenece a un grupo de guerreros mercenarios, los Takemikazuchi, largamente empleados por el actual gobierno para vencer a la facción rebelde contrarios a su política déspota. Esta banda de samurais modernos se rige por un sólido código del honor mas cercano a las antiguas ordenes feudales que a una organización pseudo-criminal. Yuki, descendiente directa de la rama consanguínea de los fundadores del clan descubrirá que su madre fue asesinada por el actual dirigente del mismo cuando intentó poner fin a las maniobras de sus miembros. Consciente de ello Yuki se volverá contra sus camaradas y tendrá que liberarse de sus deberes para ser libre.

programme.title: Bienvenido a casa
programme.desc: Aún de luto por la muerte de su esposa, Bruno está irremediablemente apegado a la cabaña junto al mar que construyeron juntos. Cuando es desalojado por sus desalmados suegros, Bruno promete recuperarlo a cualquier precio.

programme.title: Fly
programme.desc: Bex, una joven convicta, se une a un programa de rehabilitación social en la cárcel para lidiar con el doloroso trauma de su crimen. La dura líder del grupo, Ava, intenta encauzar a estos jóvenes por medio de una pasión común: el baile.

programme.title: La maniobra de Heimlich
programme.desc: A pesar de que Alex escribió un exitazo de libro acerca de técnicas de primeros auxilios su vida atenta constantemente con caer en un ahogo.

programme.title: Concursante
programme.desc: Ácida sátira de la sociedad actual. Martín Circo Martín, el afortunado ganador del mayor concurso de la historia de la televisión, recibe un premio valorado en tres millones de euros. Sin embargo, el golpe de suerte de Martín dará un vuelco a su vida convirtiéndola en una auténtica pesadilla.

programme.title: Darkness
programme.desc: En esta casa hay algo que permanece escondido. Su medio es la oscuridad. Y una nueva familia acaba de instalarse con un niño pequeño. Será la última jugada maestra de la oscuridad. Ya sólo hace falta mover las piezas. Y esperar.

programme.title: Creatura
programme.desc: Tras mudarse con su pareja a un nuevo hogar, Mila se da cuenta de que su pérdida de deseo se encuentra en sí misma. A partir de ahí, empieza un viaje en el que revisita experiencias de su infancia y adolescencia con la esperanza de reconciliarse con su propio cuerpo.

programme.title: Dirty Shield
programme.desc: Detective Ricardo Colletti's personal life is turned upside down when his wife is raped by members of a notorious street gang. When two of the gang members are found dead, Internal Affairs Bureau makes a bold move to catch their suspect.

programme.title: Vixen
programme.desc: Una hermosa pero mortífera mujer policía china debe formar equipo con un pícaro y apuesto agente de la Interpol para luchar contra los terroristas que se han apoderado del edificio más alto del mundo.

programme.title: Open Wound
programme.desc: A man and a woman are on their way to a pool party. The apparently harmless situation shifts into a dance macabre.

programme.title: Night Fright
programme.desc: A government space experiment into the effects of cosmic rays on animal life goes horribly wrong, creating a mutant monster that terrorizes a rural community.

programme.title: Kill 'Em All
programme.desc: Tras un tiroteo masivo, un misterioso desconocido (Van Damme) llega a un hospital local al borde de la muerte. Entonces, una banda extranjera se presenta descaradamente al hospital para cazarlo. Su enfermera, la única testigo superviviente del tiroteo posterior, debe enfrentarse a un interrogatorio del FBI que desvela una trama de intriga y venganza internacional. Con suficientes giros inesperados, KILL'EM ALL te mantendrá en vilo hasta el último disparo.

programme.title: Contract Killers
programme.desc: Traicionado por aquellos en los que más confiaba, un asesino a sueldo novato del gobierno descubre que es el objetivo del asesino más peligroso del mundo y así comienza un despiadado juego de matar primero o morir.

programme.title: War of the world annihilation
programme.desc: Tras una dura invasión alienígena, la única esperanza de supervivencia de una madre y su hijo reside en descubrir una verdad impensable.

programme.title: Keoma
programme.desc: Un veterano mestizo de la Unión intenta proteger su pueblo natal, asolado por la peste, de sus hermanastros racistas y de un tirano confederado.

programme.title: Fear the Night
programme.desc: Tess, una veterana de la guerra de Irak, se prepara para contraatacar después de que un grupo de asaltantes ataca su casa durante la despedida de soltera de su hermana, y descubre que están decididos a no dejar testigos.

programme.title: Zona de caza
programme.desc: Una madre huye de su marido mafioso y de sus peligrosos sicarios que intentan darle caza. Desesperada por encontrar un escondite para ella y sus hijos, se refugia en la cabaña del bosque de un excursionista llamado Jake.

programme.title: El Fantasma Rojo
programme.desc: 30 de diciembre de 1941, Vyazma es un pequeño destamento de soldados soviéticos que entran en una batalla desigual con una unidad especial de la Wehrmacht. Sin embargo, ninguno de ellos piensa en rendirse.

programme.title: Armado. La gran conspiración americana
programme.desc: Un Ex Marshall de los Estados Unidos lucha por arreglar su vida después de fracasar en una misión. Con algunos problemas de salud cree estar trastornado por los acontecimientos.

programme.title: Asia connection
programme.desc: Dos expatriados estadounidenses, Jack y Sam deciden robar un banco. Sin saberlo se han llevado el dinero de un poderoso narcotraficante.

programme.title: Juego Mortal
programme.desc: Nueve amigos despiertan con bombas en el pecho y descubren que pueden transferirse el tiempo entre ellos.

programme.title: Sin escapatoria
programme.desc: Shannon presencia un asesinato y huye de policías corruptos. Jack, un exagente, la ayuda a sobrevivir.

programme.title: Last Man Down
programme.desc: Tras una pandemia, John protege a María, portadora de una posible cura, de unos mercenarios.

programme.title: Shorta
programme.desc: Jens y Mike quedan atrapados en un gueto tras una muerte bajo custodia policial ante una turba vengativa.

programme.title: Mercenarios de élite
programme.desc: Mercenarios protegen tecnología mortal y rescatan a la hija de un CEO secuestrada por terroristas.

programme.title: Sicario: El Día del Soldado
programme.desc: La guerra contra el narcotráfico se intensifica cuando la frontera entre Estados Unidos y México se vuelve aún más brutal.

programme.title: No Respires
programme.desc: Cuenta la historia de tres jóvenes que planifican a la perfección los robos que hacen de casa en casa. Cuando entran a uno de esos hogares, atacan al inquilino, un hombre ciego y solitario. Tan pronto como intentan huir de la casa, se cambian los roles y los jóvenes se encuentran luchando por su supervivencia contra el ciego.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: ¡Vuelven Los Cazafantasmas! Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd, Harold Ramis, Rick Moranis y Sigourney Weaver. Son los auténticos cazadores de seres sobrenaturales, los únicos que pueden salvar al mundo de la fantasmagórica plaga que se extiende por todo el planeta. Ya han llegado a New York. La estatua de la libertad está en peligro.

programme.title: Kung Fu Sion
programme.desc: La historia se sitúa durante el caos pre-revolucionario de los años 40 en China. Sing (Stephen Chow) es un delincuente con poca suerte decidido a entrar en el Axe Gang, uno de los clanes mafiosos más importantes de China. Para lograrlo, Sing pretende sacar dinero de los vecinos de un bloque de casas, pero pronto descubre que éstos no son lo que parecen. La banda Axe Gang acude a la zona y una serie de sucesos lleva hasta la confrontación final entre los vecinos y los delincuentes.
